title: Transition metal chalcogenides as emerging triboelectric materials for high-performance energy harvesting devices
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,1776-1786
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01579K, Paper
Gopinath M., Rajesh Katru, Navaneeth Madathil, Pembarthi Raju, Khanapuram Uday Kumar, Ravinder Reddy Kisannagar, Inhwa Jung, Rakesh Kumar Rajaboina
Vanadium tetrasulfide (VS4) is explored as a tribopositive material to develop high-performance triboelectric nanogenerators for efficient energy harvesting and self-powered electronic applications.
